This mod adds 35+ new furniture items to the game for you to decorate your heart away. Working both indoors and outdoors.
Please note, as with vanilla, the wall items will not work inside a greenhouse. However, you can use them in the walls of a shed (or your house!)

[youtube]tSWEf6uCu18[/youtube]

This is all new furniture using Content Patcher! You can find the furniture either using something like CJB Item Spawner OR you can purchase the brand new Fairy Garden Furniture Catalogue from Robin's Shop!
